_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in tenant_id and client_id. config.json is gitignored - never commit real values. No secret is stored in this file.

auth._mode_options: interactive | secret_env | certificate. Override for one run with --auth-mode.
auth._interactive_notes: Opens your browser. Needs DELEGATED AuditLog.Read.All, Directory.Read.All, RoleManagement.Read.Directory (admin-consented) AND a 'http://localhost' redirect URI under 'Mobile and desktop applications'. The signed-in user must also hold Global Reader, Reports Reader, or Security Reader - consent alone is not enough.
auth._unattended_notes: secret_env and certificate use APPLICATION permissions of the same three names. Task Scheduler does not inherit your shell's environment, so set the secret as a persistent user or machine variable - or prefer certificate mode.

sharepoint._comment: Destination for publish_month.py. Publication is a separate, approved step - never automatic. Leave enabled false until the library exists and consent is granted.
sharepoint._site_notes: site_hostname is the tenant SharePoint host; site_path is the server-relative path to the site. Together they resolve to /sites/{hostname}:{site_path}.
sharepoint._library_notes: library is the document library DISPLAY name, not the name in the URL. The default library displays as 'Documents' but appears in SharePoint URLs as 'Shared Documents'; publish_month.py matches either, and --check lists both if the lookup fails.
sharepoint._folder_notes: Path inside the library. Slash-separated; each segment is created if absent. One folder per cycle is created beneath it.
sharepoint._style_notes: Name of the per-cycle folder. 'period' -> 2026-06, which sorts correctly and matches the project's period labels. 'monthyear' -> June2026, for a library that already uses that convention. Match whatever is already in the target library: consistency inside the library matters more than matching the project folder.
sharepoint._permission_notes: Unattended modes need the APPLICATION permission Sites.Selected, plus an administrator granting this app 'write' on this specific site - a tenant-wide Sites.ReadWrite.All grant should not be requested. Interactive mode instead uses DELEGATED Sites.ReadWrite.All and the signed-in user's own library permissions apply.
sharepoint._scope_notes: true publishes input/ and output/ both. The raw export in input/ is the irreplaceable half - Entra discards the source audit logs within its retention window - and publishing it lets auditors recompute the hashes the workbook cites. Set false, or pass --outputs-only, to publish deliverables alone.
